name: cadenceux
description: Claude skills for Claris FileMaker developers from CadenceUX: the DX routing and stack check, FileMaker Pro reference, scripting patterns and the cadenceux standards pack, plug-in references and FileMaker Server operations, built to work with Claris's FileMaker Agentic Development Kit (ADK) or without it.

plugins.name: cadenceux-dx
plugins.description: Start here for agentic FileMaker work, with or without Claris's Agentic Development Kit (ADK): routes each task to the skill or ADK tool that owns it, checks the stack is current, and guides the decisions around the code: native or web viewer, data access, FileMaker 26.0.3 and earlier, reviews, linter tests, security and deployment.

plugins.name: claris-filemaker-pro
plugins.description: FileMaker Pro reference, current to FileMaker 26.1: every calculation function and script step with exact syntax, return types, versions and seven-product platform support, plus the Data API, OData, SQL, WebDirect and FileMaker Go. Defers to Claris's Agentic Development Kit (ADK) engine when it's installed.

plugins.name: fmp-dev-design-patterns
plugins.description: Scripting conventions and design patterns for Claris FileMaker: script structure, error handling, JSON parameters and results, transactions, AI steps, naming and anti-patterns. Applies the cadenceux standards pack through Claris's Agentic Development Kit (ADK), or without it.

plugins.name: cadenceux-filemaker-standards
plugins.description: CadenceUX FileMaker naming and design-pattern conventions as a Claris ADK standards pack: Domain: Action script names, dot-notation fields and table occurrences, the CadenceUX script header, error handling and JSON script results. Apply with adk standards use cadenceux.

plugins.name: fmp-dev-orchestrator
plugins.description: Retired: replaced by cadenceux-dx. The last release only tells you to install it.

plugins.name: cadenceux-fms-docker-setup
plugins.description: Installs, upgrades and certifies Claris FileMaker Server in Docker on macOS, from Claris's arm64 Ubuntu build, with snapshot-based upgrades and rollback.

plugins.name: cadenceux-ottofms-docker-setup
plugins.description: Installs and activates OttoFMS on a Docker-hosted FileMaker Server: install, service start, Nginx /otto/ access, container commit and licence activation.

plugins.name: cadenceux-fms-security
plugins.description: Runs an interactive security check of a Claris FileMaker Server you own or manage: internet exposure and the services it shows, server settings, known CVEs live from NVD, account security in the hosted files, a log review for password spraying and bulk record downloads, several servers' logs read together, and backups checked against the data owner's limits on data loss and downtime, ending in a plain-English findings report. Offered as is; not a replacement for a professional security assessment.

plugins.name: monkeybread-mbs-plugin
plugins.description: Reference for the MBS FileMaker Plugin from Monkeybread Software: every documented function with signature, parameters, platform support, licensing status and readable script examples, built from the vendor's documentation.

plugins.name: goya-be-plugin
plugins.description: Reference for the free, open-source BaseElements FileMaker plug-in by Goya: every BE_ function and constant with signatures, platform support, version history and deprecations.

plugins.name: beezwax-bbox-plugin
plugins.description: Reference for the free bBox FileMaker plug-in by Beezwax Datatools: shell, AppleScript, Python, Node, cURL, DuckDB/SQLite, jq, images, pasteboard and web viewer functions, with mode flags and error handling.

plugins.name: cadenceux-skill-creator
plugins.description: Builds, updates and reviews Claude skills to Anthropic's skill authoring best practices: evals first, progressive disclosure, a validator script, Haiku/Sonnet/Opus testing, and packaging for GitHub, plugin marketplaces and Claude.ai.

plugins.name: cadenceux-github
plugins.description: Shares a FileMaker developer's Claude skill on GitHub: creating the account, scrubbing client material, the plugin and marketplace files, release .zip and .skill archives built from a tag, updates, and reviewing published skills for unreleased changes.
